adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`, `findMembers()` builds the request URL from `this.get('name')` (`/groups/<name>/members.json`). In the admin group editor template (`admin/templates/group.hbs`), the group `name` is editable via a bound `text-field`, while paging (`next`/`previous`) and post-mutation reloads call `model.findMembers()` (paging actions in `admin-group.js.es6`; `addMembers`/`removeMember` call `findMembers()` after PUT/DELETE). If an admin edits the name but hasn’t saved yet, subsequent paging or reload after add/remove will use the unsaved new name and can request a non-existent/wrong group members endpoint. This behavior is directly introduced/exposed by the new paging and reload-on-mutation flow combined with name-based URL construction.
